title: Visits Covered by a Second-Opinion Referral — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Referral computation sheet — second-opinion referrals under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

1. A second-opinion referral covers the consultation visit: **1 visit**.
2. The visits covered never exceed the practice type's single-referral visit ceiling, applied to the visit figure as the last step.
3. Every figure is a whole number of visits, so no rounding arises.

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Consultation visit | 1 |
| Ceiling | The single-referral visit ceiling of the practice type of the member's active assignment |

**Worked figure (hypothetical input).** For a member whose practice type has a single-referral visit ceiling of 6, the consultation visit of 1 is within the ceiling, and the second-opinion referral records **1** visit.
